actions.description: The actions of the week, ranked by loss avoided per effort.

detections.description: The detection rules drafted for this action.

mode.description: How the action is carried out: a ticket for a person, a change applied through a bound integration under the gate ctem.production_change, or both (applied now, ticket for tracking).

ticket_draft.description: The ticket body for the ticketing target. Only sync_ctem_case_ticket opens the case ticket, once the case passed Mobilize; this field never files one. Empty for an applied_change action.

applied_change.description: For mode applied_change or both: the change applied through a bound integration under ctem.production_change.

integration.description: The bound integration that carries it (the tool's provider and the integration name).

pushed.description: What is pushed: the indicators with their action (block, prevent), scope and expiry; the rule; the setting.

ids.description: The ids the integration returned; empty while proposed.

rollback.description: How to revert it: what to delete or set back, by id.

retest.description: The re-test that proves the action.

version_match.description: For an upgrade: the version match get_ctem_case answers. blind is true when the running version or the affected range is unknown; the action then says verify the running version, then upgrade.

running.description: The versions the assets run with their counts, or unknown with the reason.

affected.description: The affected version range, or unknown with the reason.
